tours.title: Achakaiyndy → Tash-Rabat → Chatyr-Kol Horse Trek
tours.description: Multi-day horse expedition through the stunning At-Bashy gorges to Tash-Rabat caravanserai and Chatyr-Kol lake.
highlights: Ride through At-Bashy mountains and gorges

itinerary.title: Bishkek – Achakaiyndy – First Ride
itinerary.description: Early morning departure from Bishkek. Drive to Achakaiyndy village (approx. 5-6 hours). Meet your horses and guide. Begin horse trek through scenic valleys. Overnight in yurt camp or guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Through At-Bashy Gorges
itinerary.description: Full day of horse riding through dramatic At-Bashy gorges. Stunning mountain views, alpine meadows, and traditional nomadic settlements. Camping under the stars.

itinerary.title: At-Bashy Mountains
itinerary.description: Continue through high mountain passes. Encounter local nomadic families. Learn about traditional Kyrgyz culture and hospitality. Overnight in yurt camp.

itinerary.title: Tash-Rabat Caravanserai
itinerary.description: Ride to the historic Tash-Rabat caravanserai (15th century). Explore the ancient Silk Road trading post. Overnight near Tash-Rabat.

itinerary.title: Tash-Rabat – Chatyr-Kol
itinerary.description: Depart Tash-Rabat and ride towards Chatyr-Kol lake. High altitude plateau with breathtaking views. Overnight by the lake.

itinerary.title: Chatyr-Kol Lake
itinerary.description: Explore Chatyr-Kol lake and surrounding area. Optional short hikes. Relax and enjoy the pristine nature. Overnight in yurt camp.

itinerary.title: Return Journey
itinerary.description: Begin return journey through At-Bashy. Farewell dinner with local family. Overnight in guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Achakaiyndy – Bishkek
itinerary.description: Final ride to Achakaiyndy. Drive back to Bishkek (5-6 hours). Tour ends in the evening.

included: Organizer fee (30%) for logistics and coordination

faq.question: What is the difficulty level?
faq.answer: Moderate to Challenging. Suitable for riders with some experience. Long days in the saddle and high altitude.

faq.question: Do I need previous horse riding experience?
faq.answer: Yes, basic horse riding experience is recommended. Our guides will provide instruction, but comfort on horseback is important for multi-day treks.

faq.question: What is the best time to visit?
faq.answer: May to September offers the best weather and trail conditions. July and August are warmest, but also most popular.

faq.question: What should I pack?
faq.answer: Riding boots or sturdy shoes, warm layers, waterproof jacket, sun protection, personal medications, and a small daypack.

faq.question: Is travel insurance required?
faq.answer: Yes, we strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance that covers horse riding and emergency evacuation.

tours.title: Tash-Rabat – Arpa – Aksay – Kel-Suu 4x4
tours.description: Off-road loop via high mountain passes to the turquoise Kel-Suu lake with scenic stops along the way.

itinerary.title: Bishkek – Tash-Rabat
itinerary.description: Early departure from Bishkek. Drive via Bishkek – Osh highway to Tash-Rabat caravanserai (approx. 8-9 hours). Explore the ancient Silk Road site. Overnight near Tash-Rabat.

itinerary.title: Tash-Rabat – Arpa – Aksay
itinerary.description: Off-road adventure through Arpa valley and high mountain passes. Stunning views of Naryn region. Drive through Aksay canyon. Overnight in guesthouse or yurt camp.

itinerary.title: Aksay – Kel-Suu – Bishkek
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Kel-Suu lake. Time for photos and short walks by the turquoise waters. Return journey to Bishkek (approx. 7-8 hours).

faq.answer: We use comfortable 4x4 vehicles (Toyota Land Cruiser or similar) suitable for mountain roads and off-road sections.

faq.question: Are the roads difficult?
faq.answer: Some sections are unpaved and can be rough, especially after rain. Our experienced drivers ensure a safe and comfortable journey.

faq.question: Can we extend the tour?

tours.title: Chuy – Issyk-Kul Road Trip
tours.description: Flexible road trip: Bishkek → Tokmok → Burana → Tash-Moinok → Issyk-Kul (Grigoryevka, Semenovka, Karakol, Jety-Oguz, Jomok-Say, Aksay, etc.). Fully customizable.

itinerary.title: Bishkek – Tokmok – Burana – Tash-Moinok – Issyk-Kul
itinerary.description: Depart Bishkek. Visit Tokmok city and Burana Tower (11th century minaret). Continue to Tash-Moinok canyon for spectacular views. Drive to Issyk-Kul lakeside (Grigoryevka or Semenovka). Overnight at lake.

itinerary.title: Issyk-Kul Exploration
itinerary.description: Explore Issyk-Kul lake area. Options: Karakol city, Jety-Oguz rock formations, Grigoryevka gorge, Semenovka beach, or Jomok-Say canyon. Customizable based on preferences. Overnight at lake.

itinerary.title: Issyk-Kul – Bishkek
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure by the lake. Return journey to Bishkek via scenic route. Optional stops en route. Tour ends in Bishkek in the evening.
